(30 November) |longest wins = |longest unbeaten = |longest losses = |prevseason= [[2023 Ecuadorian Serie A|2023]] |nextseason= [[2025 Ecuadorian Serie A|2025]] }} The '''2024 Campeonato Ecuatoriano de Fútbol Serie A''', officially known as the '''LigaPro Ecuabet 2024''' for sponsoring purposes,{{cite web|url=https://www.ole.com.ar/ecuador/liga-pro/ligapro-ecuabet-acuerdo-patrocinio-title-sponsor-torneo-futbol-seriea_0_7zQzSUzCdy.html|title=LigaPro Ecuabet, una nueva era en el fútbol ecuatoriano|trans-title=LigaPro Ecuabet, a new era in Ecuadorian football|publisher=[[Olé (sports newspaper)|Olé]]|language=es|date=22 January 2024|access-date=3 February 2024}} was the 66th season of the [[Ecuadorian Serie A|Serie A]], Ecuador's top tier [[Association football|football]] league, and the sixth under the management of the ''Liga Profesional de Fútbol del Ecuador'' (or LigaPro). The season was originally scheduled to begin on 16 February 2024,{{cite web|url=https://www.primicias.ec/noticias/jugada/ligapro-temporada-2024-futbol-ecuador/|title=La LigaPro 2024 iniciará el viernes 16 febrero|trans-title=The 2024 LigaPro will start on Friday 16 February|publisher=Primicias|language=es|date=20 December 2023|access-date=25 December 2023}} but it was postponed for two weeks to 1 March due to the security conditions derived from the [[2024 Ecuadorian conflict]],{{cite web|url=https://studiofutbol.com.ec/2024/02/02/oficial-la-ligapro-ecuabet-iniciara-en-el-mes-de-marzo/|title=OFICIAL: La LigaPro Ecuabet iniciará en el mes de marzo|trans-title=OFFICIAL: The LigaPro Ecuabet will start in the month of March|publisher=Studio Fútbol|language=es|date=2 February 2024|access-date=3 February 2024}} and ended on 14 December 2024. The fixtures for the season were announced on 23 January 2024.{{cite web|url=https://www.ole.com.ar/ecuador/liga-pro/develan-calendario-partidos-torneo-ligapro-ecuabet-hora-evento-tele_0_D7FKKLKGTz.html|title=El fixture completo de la LigaPro Ecuabet 2024|trans-title=The 2024 LigaPro Ecuabet's full fixture|publisher=[[Olé (sports newspaper)|Olé]]|language=es|date=23 January 2024|access-date=3 February 2024}} The defending champions [[L.D.U. Quito|LDU Quito]] won their thirteenth league title in this season, defeating [[Independiente del Valle]] in the finals by a 3–1 aggregate score.{{cite web|url=https://www.ole.com.ar/ecuador/liga-pro/liga-quito-independiente-valle-partido-final-ligapro-ecuador_0_mmo1p8tvqM.html|title=Yo te daré... ¡Liga de Quito es bicampeón de Ecuador!|trans-title=I'll give you... Liga de Quito is Ecuador's two-time champion!|publisher=[[Olé (sports newspaper)|Olé]]|language=es|date=14 December 2024|access-date=14 December 2024}} ==Teams== 16 teams competed in the season. [[Gualaceo S.C.|Gualaceo]] and [[Guayaquil City F.C.|Guayaquil City]] were relegated after finishing in the bottom two places of the aggregate table of the previous season, being replaced by the [[2023 Ecuadorian Serie B|2023 Serie B]] champions [[C.S.D. Macará|Macará]] and runners-up [[Imbabura S.C.|Imbabura]]. Macará clinched promotion to the top flight with five matches to go after defeating Vargas Torres 2–0 on 21 September 2023, making an immediate return to top flight,{{cite web|url=https://www.primicias.ec/noticias/jugada/macara-vargas-torres-ascenso-seriea/|title=¡Retorno Celeste! Macará gana y regresa a la Serie A para 2024|trans-title=''Sky Blue'' return! Macará win and return to the Serie A for 2024|publisher=Primicias|language=es|date=21 September 2023|accessdate=6 December 2023}} whilst Imbabura ensured promotion in the last round played on 26 October, with a 4–0 victory over Macará, returning to the top flight after a 12-year absence.{{cite web|url=https://www.ole.com.ar/ecuador/liga-pro/imbabura-consiguio-ascenso-ligapro-serie_0_HldTUmM5Mn.html|title=¡Imbabura consiguió el ascenso a la Serie A!|trans-title=Imbabura achieved promotion to the Serie A!|publisher=[[Olé (sports newspaper)|Olé]]|language=es|date=26 October 2023|accessdate=6 December 2023}} ===Stadia and locations=== {{location map+ |Ecuador |float=right |width=425 |caption=Locations of the 2024 Serie A clubs. |places= {{location map~ |Ecuador |lat=-0.278724 |long=-78.546433 |label=
